messages.author: 29a8b572e047fd3e
messages.subject: Integrating RRO with Applications
parts:
Will RRO work with R.NET and other application interfaces that allow line of business applications to directly interface to R?  It sounds like RRO is more stable than R and may have fixed some of the concurrency issues that currently exist in R.  Just curious to see if anyone else was trying to integrate to RRO.

Thanks,

SEH.

messages.author: 88275a537c4bd7d2
messages.subject: Re: [RRO] Integrating RRO with Applications
parts:
Hi Scott,

You might want to take a look at DeployR Open: http://deployr.revolutionanalytics.com/dev/ . It's designed to work with Revolution R Open, and provides a REST API for R functions with can be called from .NET, Java, and other application languages.

Let us know if that's the kind of thing you are looking for.

Thanks,
# David
